Daily Devotional

November 25

24 God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth. (John 4:24 KJV)

This verse is so very important to understanding our relationship with God. Since God is a Spirit, then we must relate to Him through our spirits, and when He looks at us, He looks at our spirits, and not at our actions and thoughts. This is why, when we have been born again in our spirits, we can have relationship with the Father (John 17:3), as our new spirit is the Spirit of Jesus (Galatians 4:6), and is just as holy and righteous as Jesus is. This explains why the Christian can come boldly right into the Throne room of God, and we can converse with Him without going through a priest. The bible tells us that we, that have been born again, are royal priests ourselves (1 Peter 2:9), giving us access directly with the Father. WOW – God sees us that are born again, as royal priests just like Jesus. That is so awesome, that God sees us in our spirits, and doesn’t look at the things we constantly do that are not pleasing to Him.

The more a Christian can walk in the spirit, rather than the flesh, the closer we can come to being like God, and the better we can have relationship with Him. Christians can still walk after the flesh, but it will hinder the relationship with God, as He only relates to us through the spirit. Even if we walk after the flesh, it does not mean that God will not hear us, or answer our prayers, but if we sin, we are giving the devil an opportunity to come at us with sickness, depression, etc (John 10:10). Living a holy life does not affect God’s love for us, but living in sin will affect our love for Him, and harden our hearts toward Him, so we need to live as holy as we can to keep the devil at bay (1 Peter 1:16). Christians should realize that the holier they live, keeps the devil away, and makes us more like the Jesus that we love. Live holy and let your light shine in this dark world (Matthew 5:16) – thereby glorifying the Lord by walking after the spirit.
